title: Digital Alchemy
style: Synth-pop with cyberpunk pulse, fast 120 BPM and a driving four-on-the-floor kick; verse rides clipped arps and rubbery bass, pre-chorus tightens with filtered risers, chorus opens on stacked saw synths and gang vocal hooks. Vocal is close-mic, glossy, with doubled choruses, short delay throws, and glitchy ad-libs. Ear candy: reversed swells, data-chirp fills, and a hard tape-stop before the final lift. Bright, neon-bright mix with a punchy low end., punk, blues, deep, pop, acoustic, rock, electronic, beats
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
No more blank pages, no more acoustic acoustic guitar chords
We’re feeding millions of songs straight into the motherboard
Thousands of hours, the classics, the indie, the blues
Vast datasets of audio files that the matrix can use

[Chorus]
Just type in the genre!
Just input the mood!
The machine predicts the next frequency wave
From a text prompt to a track
That can rock a rave!

[Verse 2]
Neural networks and Transformers are locked in the brain
Analyzing the patterns of rhythm, the pleasure, the pain
Chop the file into tokens, semantic and tight
Reconstructing the sound waves deep in the night
Some models take images of pure sound design
Spectrograms painting audio line by line
